extraction_notes: PDF SHA-256 verified as 23d893091fe0842932d1a6f6818549c6405b6e774142dc6f5a848dde12e353fc before extraction.
The supplied datasheet identifies LMBT4401LT1G and S-LMBT4401LT1G as LRC (Leshan Radio Company, Ltd.) NPN silicon general-purpose transistors; the exact requested MPN is LMBT4401LT1G.
The electrical-characteristics table states TA = 25 degC unless otherwise noted. The pulse-test note specifies pulse width <300 us and duty cycle <2.0%.
Curve points are sparse manual digitizations at visible grid positions from the typical characteristic plots on pages 3 and 4; no points were interpolated between sampled observations.
Curve axes labelled in mA, uA, pF, or MHz were represented in SI units A, F, and Hz. NPN voltage and current values retain the datasheet positive signs.

The DC current gain table provides guaranteed minimum hFE values at IC = 0.1, 1, 10, 150, and 500 mA, plus a maximum of 300 at 150 mA. The guaranteed 150 mA range is preserved as separate minimum and maximum gain points.

The first base-emitter saturation row publishes a minimum of 0.75 V and maximum of 0.95 V; the second row publishes only a maximum of 1.2 V. VCE(sat) is a maximum of 0.4 V at 150 mA and 0.75 V at 500 mA.

The strict BJT schema has no fields for VCBO, VEBO, continuous IC, power and thermal ratings, switching times, or other small-signal h-parameter rows; those available table fields were not added outside the schema.
